integrity: Analytical polyhedral-projection proof with fully exhaustive rational finite-n checker; one fixed claim shared by result, slogan and review. Same-model scientific review only; no independent audit or priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact simple constants are proved only for n=2,...,8; all n have an exact finite active-face maximum and monotonicity. Equally spaced unweighted real least-squares data and unweighted open-path total variation only. No general closed formula or asymptotic limit is asserted.
title: Sharp two-input path-variation sensitivity of convex least-squares regression
